visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young Asian boy with short black hair stands facing a dark grey wall, his forehead and nose pressed against it. He is wearing a light blue and yellow long-sleeved shirt. Behind him stands a white cylindrical air purifier in a bright, clean indoor setting. (2) The boy turns his head slightly, revealing pouting lips and teary eyes. The camera angle is at eye-level, occasionally zooming into his facial expressions. A man with shoulder-length brown hair and a white t-shirt enters the frame to interact with him. (3) The scene transitions to a living room with a beige sofa. The boy is now sitting with the man, wearing a different sweater that features a cartoon rice ball graphic. The man uses his hands to comfort the boy, wiping tears from his face. (4) The boy is held in the man's arms on the sofa. He goes through a range of emotions from sobbing to giggling as they play. The man picks the boy up and carries him away from the sofa in a 'prince carry' pose as the video ends.
